answer: Farming becomes a dune bet on surviving 72 epochs of grading, and every juniper settlement recomputes the anchor schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 72 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
